paper.title: A comparative study of hydrogen adsorption on superactivated carbon versus carbon nanotubes

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-derivation of Table 1): 8 rows, 0 numeric disputes (every wt% at 6 MPa/60 bar cross-checked against the paper's own nAC/nNT ratio column; the 318 K isotherm is not tabulated and was correctly not added). AX-21 (activated_carbon/commercial, BET ~3000 surface_area_method=unspecified) vs MWNT (MWCNT/cvd, BET 137 from N2/77 K, acid-purified). uptake_type=unspecified; He void-space-expansion calibration earned. Tiers: AX-21 M1-M4 Tier B; MWNT M5-M8 Tier A (9/10 -- unspecified uptake_type does not bar Tier A under S13.3). Agent C: pore_volume_probe_gas N2->blank on the AX-21 rows (the paper gives AX-21's pore volume with no gas/method; the only 'N2 at 77 K' is MWNT's BET, a different sample).

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified (exact-word rule): the paper says 'amount of H2 adsorbed'/'weight percentage'; neither 'excess' nor 'total' is used
notes.method: H2 by the volumetric method (reference cell + adsorption cell); void volume by He expansion; compressibility-corrected -> measurement_method=volumetric_sieverts, calibration point by hand (He void determination)
notes.ax21: AX-21 superactivated carbon: the paper gives 'about 3000 m2/g' and pore volume 'about 1.3 cm3/g' without a method, so surface_area_method=unspecified and the values are recorded as the stated approximates; class=activated_carbon, commercial
notes.mwnt: MWNT by catalytic decomposition of acetylene over LaCoO3, purified (toluene/methanol, HCl/HNO3, CO2 oxidation); BET 137 m2/g (N2, 77 K); class=MWCNT, synthesis_method=cvd
notes.temps: isotherms at 233/253/273/298 K, all read at 6 MPa (=60 bar) from Table 1
notes.heat: isosteric heat of adsorption (AX-21 -6.4, MWNT -1.7 kJ/mol) has no schema field and is noted here only

S1.label: AX-21
S1.material_description: commercial superactivated carbon AX-21 (~3000 m2/g, pore volume ~1.3 cm3/g)

S2.label: MWNT
S2.material_description: multiwalled carbon nanotubes by catalytic decomposition of acetylene over LaCoO3, purified; wall thickness and inner diameter ~10 nm
S2.purification_method: washed in toluene/methanol then HCl/HNO3; amorphous carbon removed by CO2 oxidation
